req.title: Retrieve player by ID
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/{playerId} with the corresponding player object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /players/{playerId} returning HTTP 200 with a matching Player object. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid UUID returns 200 + correct player fields; (2) negative NEG — non-existent UUID returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — malformed/non-UUID path segment returns 422; (4) additional EP — first and last seeded rows to catch off-by-one in DB lookup; (5) DT — verify every field in the response matches the seeded row exactly, catching field-mapping mutations. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with pre-loaded fixture data.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_existing_returns_200_with_correct_body
preconditions: Database contains player with id=97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802 and squadNumber=1
expected: Response body matches all fields of the seeded player row exactly
trace: R-PLAYER-002: system shall respond with HTTP 200 and matching Player object
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_existing_returns_200_with_correct_body():
    player_id = '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == player_id
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['middleName'] == ''
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1901-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'GK'
    assert body['team'] == 'Manchester City'
    assert body['league'] == 'Serie A'
    assert body['starting11'] == False
